packages are lightweight, framework-specific versions of Nuxt I18n Micro designed for integration into various frameworks and environments. These packages provide core internationalization functionality with a minimal footprint, focusing on essential translation features and basic components.
of the full Nuxt I18n Micro module, containing only the essential functionality needed for internationalization:
- Basic translation methods, pluralization, and formatting
- A small set of UI components for common i18n tasks
- Flexible routing integration through adapter abstraction
- Full type definitions for type-safe development
Unlike the full Nuxt module, these packages:
Do not include framework-specific routing logic
Require you to implement a router adapter for routing features
Focus on translation functionality rather than framework integration

A translation component that renders translated text with support for:
- Automatic plural form selection based on count
- Fallback text when translation is missing

A localized link component that automatically handles locale prefixes in URLs. Features:
- Adds/removes locale prefixes based on routing strategy
- Automatically detects and handles external URLs
- Uses router adapter's link component when available

// React
<I18nLink to="/about" activeStyle={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
  About Us
</I18nLink>

// Solid
<I18nLink to="/about" activeStyle={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
  About Us
</I18nLink>
A language switcher component that provides a dropdown or list interface for changing locales. Features:
- Support for custom display names per locale
- Proper ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation
A component for grouping translations with a common prefix, useful for organizing translations by page or feature. Features:
- Automatically prepends prefix to all translation keys within the group

<!-- Vue -->
<I18nGroup prefix="home">
  <I18nT keypath="title" /> <!-- Uses "home.title" -->
  <I18nT keypath="description" /> <!-- Uses "home.description" -->
</I18nGroup>

<!-- Astro -->
<I18nGroup prefix="home">
  <I18nT keypath="title" /> <!-- Uses "home.title" -->
  <I18nT keypath="description" /> <!-- Uses "home.description" -->
</I18nGroup>
